chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Be independent of people, even if it is with the splinter of a toothstick."

key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: The toothstick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.النَّاسِ: People; others from whom one may seek assistance
key_terms.اِسْتَغْنُوا: Seek independence and avoid neediness before others
key_terms.بِشَوْصِ: Even with something very small, such as a tiny piece or splinter

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام teach about being independent from people?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام teaches self-sufficiency and discourages dependence on others, even in the smallest matters. The saying emphasizes dignity, restraint, and seeking to manage one’s needs independently whenever possible.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1759 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said:
"Be independent of people, even if it is with the splinters of a toothstick."
